housing.summary: Numbeo's Gent cost-of-living table (last updated 23 July 2026) reports EUR 1,055.62 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gent). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 caps the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Ghent) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Ghent (postcode 9000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/ghent/9000).

banking.summary: Requires: valid passport/ID and proof of Belgian residence. Banks: ING Belgium, Belfius.

schools.summary: International schools in Ghent offering IB and Flemish curricula.

legal_admin.summary: Register at Ghent city administration within 8 days of arrival.
legal_admin.registration_step: Visit Ghent stadtskantoor (city office) within 8 days of arrival to declare residence.

tax_finance.summary: Tax ID is National Register Number (NN/RRN)¨ assigned automatically upon commune registration.
